requirements.title: Infinite Canvas Whiteboard
requirements.description: The editor must provide an infinite canvas-based whiteboard interface for drawing and sketching.
acceptance: User can draw and position elements anywhere on an unbounded canvas area.

requirements.title: Hand-Drawn Visual Style
requirements.description: The editor must render elements in a hand-drawn sketchy aesthetic.
acceptance: Drawn shapes and lines are displayed on the canvas in a hand-drawn style.

requirements.title: Dark Mode Support
requirements.description: The editor must support a dark theme display mode.
acceptance: User can toggle or view the canvas and user interface in dark mode.

requirements.title: Image Support
requirements.description: The editor must support inserting images onto the canvas.
acceptance: User can insert image files into the drawing canvas as elements.

requirements.title: Shape Libraries Support
requirements.description: The editor must support loading and using shape libraries.
acceptance: User can access and insert elements from shape libraries onto the canvas.

requirements.title: Export to PNG, SVG, and Clipboard
requirements.description: The editor must allow users to export canvas drawings to PNG, SVG, or copy them to the clipboard.
acceptance: User can export drawing to a PNG file.
User can export drawing to an SVG file.
User can copy drawing output directly to system clipboard.

requirements.title: Excalidraw Format Import and Export
requirements.description: The editor must support exporting and loading drawings using the native open JSON format (.excalidraw).
acceptance: User can export drawings as an .excalidraw JSON file.
User can import and load an .excalidraw file into the canvas.

requirements.title: Core Drawing Tools
requirements.description: The editor must provide core tools including rectangle, circle, diamond, arrow, line, free-draw, and eraser.
acceptance: User can select and draw using rectangle, circle, diamond, arrow, line, and free-draw tools.
User can erase elements using the eraser tool.

requirements.title: Arrow Binding and Text Labels
requirements.description: The editor must support binding arrows to elements and adding text labels to arrows.
acceptance: Arrows can automatically bind their endpoints to shapes on the canvas.
Text labels can be attached to arrow paths.

requirements.title: Undo and Redo Capabilities
requirements.description: The editor must support undoing and redoing drawing actions.
acceptance: Triggering undo reverts the latest user modification.
Triggering redo re-applies the previously undone action.

requirements.title: Zoom and Canvas Panning
requirements.description: The editor must allow users to zoom in/out and pan across the canvas view.
acceptance: User can pan the canvas to view different coordinate regions.
User can zoom in and out to adjust view magnification.

requirements.title: Progressive Web App Offline Support
requirements.description: The application must support PWA capabilities enabling offline usage.
acceptance: Application opens and functions without an active internet connection.

requirements.title: Real-Time Multi-User Collaboration
requirements.description: The application must support live real-time collaboration between multiple users.
acceptance: Changes performed by one participant are reflected in real time for other connected participants.

requirements.title: End-to-End Encryption
requirements.description: Collaborative sessions must be end-to-end encrypted.
acceptance: Data exchanged during real-time sessions is encrypted end-to-end.

requirements.title: Local-First Browser Autosave
requirements.description: The application must automatically save drawing state directly to the user's browser storage.
acceptance: Drawing modifications automatically persist in local browser storage without requiring explicit user saves.

requirements.title: Read-Only Shareable Links
requirements.description: The application must allow users to generate read-only shareable links for drawings.
acceptance: User can generate a shareable URL for a drawing.
Opening the shareable URL opens the drawing in a read-only view.

requirements.title: Internationalization and Localization
requirements.description: The editor must support internationalization (i18n) for localizing interface text.
acceptance: User interface text can be displayed in multiple localized languages.

requirements.title: Mermaid Diagram Conversion
requirements.description: The system must support converting Mermaid diagram definitions into native Excalidraw canvas elements.
acceptance: Mermaid syntax can be converted and rendered into Excalidraw canvas shapes.
